description_en: Queries information about one or more of your Elastic Block Storage (EBS) disks
description_zh: 查询一块或多块您已经创建的块存储云盘
kebab_example: aliyun ebs describe-lens-monitor-disks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-ids d-cd40hxfu0v00000 --disk-category cloud_auto --lens-tags NoSnapshot --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --disk-id-pattern d-cd40hxfu0v0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLensMonitorDisks

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the list of regions that support EBS Lens
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。您可以调用 DescribeRegions 查询块存储数据洞察支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The category of the disk. Valid values:

cloud: basic disk.

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.

cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

cloud_essd: Enhanced SSD (ESSD).

cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL disk.

cloud_essd_entry: ESSD Entry disk
parameters.help_zh:
云盘类型。取值范围：

cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD 盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD 云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL 云盘。
cloud_essd_entry：ESSD Entry 云盘
parameters.name: disk_category

parameters.help_en:
A list of event tags. This parameter is used to filter disks for which the specified types of events occurred within the last 24 hours. Valid values:

NoSnapshot: data protection

BurstIOTriggered: burst I/O

CostOptimizationNeeded: cost optimization

DiskSpecNotMatchedWithInstance: The disk specifications do not match the instance type.

DiskIONo4kAligned: non-4K aligned read/write

DiskIOHang: An I/O hang occurred on the disk.

InstanceIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: The IOPS of the instance has reached its upper limit.

InstanceBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: The BPS of the instance has reached its upper limit.

DiskIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: The IOPS of the disk has reached the upper limit of the instance.

DiskBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: The BPS of the disk has reached the upper limit of the instance.

DiskIOPSExceedDiskMaxLimit: The IOPS of the disk has reached its upper limit.

DiskBPSExceedDiskMaxLimit: The BPS of the disk has reached its upper limit
parameters.help_zh:
云盘事件标签列表，用于筛选24小时内发生过这些事件类型的云盘。取值范围：
NoSnapshot：数据保护
BurstIOTriggered：突发IO
CostOptimizationNeeded：成本优化
DiskSpecNotMatchedWithInstance：实例与云盘规格不匹配
DiskIONo4kAligned：非4K对齐读写
DiskIOHang：云盘有IOHang发生
InstanceIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：实例IOPS到达上限
InstanceBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：实例BPS到达上限
DiskIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：云盘IOPS到达实例上限
DiskBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：云盘BPS到达实例上限
DiskIOPSExceedDiskMaxLimit：云盘IOPS到达磁盘上限
DiskBPSExceedDiskMaxLimit：云盘BPS到达磁盘上限
parameters.name: lens_tags

parameters.help_en: The token used to start the next query. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from a previous call to this operation
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.
Default value:

10.

If you set this parameter to a value greater than 100, the default value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为 100。
默认值：

默认值为 10。

当设置的值大于 100 时，默认值为 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A regular expression to filter disk IDs in a fuzzy query
parameters.help_zh: 正则匹配模糊查询筛选云盘ID
parameters.name: disk_id_pattern

Bps.description_zh: 每秒读写（I/O）成功传输的数据数量上限，单位：MB/s

BurstingEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the performance burst feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No.

This parameter is returned only when `DiskCategory` is set to `cloud_auto`. For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL disks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）
BurstingEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启Burst（性能突发）。可能值：

true：是。
false：否。

当`DiskCategory`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见[ESSD AutoPL 云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）

DiskCategory.description_en:
The category of the disk. Valid values:

cloud: basic disk.

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.

cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

cloud_essd: ESSD.

cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL disk.

cloud_essd_entry: ESSD Entry disk
DiskCategory.description_zh:
云盘类型。取值范围：

cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD 盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD 云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL 云盘。
cloud_essd_entry：ESSD Entry 云盘

DiskStatus.description_en:
The status of the disk. Valid values:

Available: in use.

Deleted: deleted
DiskStatus.description_zh:
云盘状态。可能值：
Available：使用中。
Deleted：已删除

DiskType.description_en:
The type of the disk. Valid values:

system: system disk.

data: data disk
DiskType.description_zh:
云盘类型。可能值：

system：系统盘。
data：数据盘

Iops.description_en: The maximum number of input/output operations per second (IOPS)
Iops.description_zh: 每秒读写（I/O）操作的次数上限，单位：次/s

LensTags.description_en: A collection of event tags for the disk. The event tags indicate the events that occurred on the disk in the last 24 hours. The data may have a delay of up to 1 hour
LensTags.description_zh: 云盘的事件标签集合。事件标签展示云盘24小时内发生过的事件，相比事件有1小时之内的延迟

items.description_en: The event tag of the disk

PerformanceLevel.description_en:
The performance level of the ESSD. Valid values:

PL0: A maximum of 10,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.

PL1: A maximum of 50,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.

PL2: A maximum of 100,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.

PL3: A maximum of 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS per disk
PerformanceLevel.description_zh:
ESSD云盘的性能等级。可能值：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

ProvisionedIops.description_en:
The provisioned read/write IOPS of the ESSD AutoPL disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50000, 1000 * capacity - baseline performance}.

Baseline performance = min{1,800 + 50 * capacity, 50,000}.

This parameter is returned only when `DiskCategory` is set to `cloud_auto`. For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL disks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）
ProvisionedIops.description_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50000, 1000*容量-基准性能}。

基准性能=min{1,800+50*容量, 50,000}。

当`DiskCategory`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见[ESSD AutoPL 云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）

SharingEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether the disk is a shared disk

Size.description_en: The size of the disk, in GiB

Tags.description_en: The collection of tags for the disk

ZoneId.description_en: The ID of the zone to which the disk belongs

NextToken.description_en: The token to use to retrieve the next page of results. This value is not returned when there are no more results to return
NextToken.description_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
NextToken.title_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is returned for every request, regardless of the result
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。无论调用接口成功与否，我们都会返回请求 ID
RequestId.title_zh: 请求ID。无论调用接口成功与否，我们都会返回请求 ID。
